mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, phone, dept, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{dept}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type = 2 AND m.status = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != ''
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0
